content:
ellen: Heads-up from design review: the compare table feels "stale" to users when they change filters in the left rail. We need a clearer visual state + a non-destructive flow to bring results up-to-date.

rhea: Can we avoid surprising behavior where pinned rows disappear? Product preference is to never auto-remove pinned models.

omar: In remote sessions people expect one of three things: live-sync, frozen snapshot, or a clear warning that filters changed. They liked an inline banner more than tiny pills.

 tom: Proposal: add a slim banner above the compare table with states: "Up to date" (green, hidden), "Filters changed" (yellow with CTA), "Snapshot" (gray, timestamp). Banner should include small link "Apply catalog filters" and a chevron to open advanced options.

 kai: Implementation note: apply should re-run the filter query against the current pinset: GET /compare?pins=[ids]&filters=current. Must ensure we do not alter pin order or remove pinned ids. Any newly matching models are appended as "new" rows with a compact "new" badge.

 elllen: Banner copy suggestion: 1) Filters changed — show "Catalog filters changed since you opened compare" + CTA "Show updates". 2) Snapshot — "Comparing pinned models as of 11:03" + CTA "Sync now". Keep phrases short.

 omar: Accessibility: banner must be focusable, keyboard tabbable, and announce changes with aria-live polite. For the "new" rows, also announce "2 new models added" after update.

 tom: For the CTA we should use a role=button anchor with aria-pressed? No, it's an action. Use <button aria-label="Show updated results">Show updates</button>. Also add data-analytics attr.

 ellen: Visual details: use left-aligned micro icon (info/warning) then copy. Banner height 36px, 12px padding, 10px text. Color tokens: use theme.badge.warning-600 on light, not the current pale yellow which fails contrast on older screens.

 kai: Perf note: re-running filters may be expensive on huge catalogs. We'll add a debounce (1s) and server-side cache key for identical queries. Also limit auto-sync to workspace owners on large orgs by config.

 rhea: What about the version pinning modal? People confused by "Lock version" vs "Pin version". Suggest we change wording to "Pin model version" and make it clear pinning affects only compare until unpinned.

 tom: Modal microcopy: header "Pin model version". Body: "Pin this model version to keep it in compares and prevent automatic upgrades. You can unpin anytime." Buttons: Primary "Pin version" / Secondary "Cancel". Add a small link "Why pin versions?" that opens help.

 omar: In tests, folks worried pinning = permanent. Add inline note: "Pinning does not archive or lock the model from updates in catalog; it's local to your compares and sessions."

 elllen: Badges: performance badge currently shows "lat 95ms" in 10px label. Users miss it. Options: increase to 12px and use semibold, or keep small but add hover card with full metrics. Prefer increasing font size to improve legibility. Also update color tokens for contrast.

 kai: Layout constraints: increasing badge font may break single-line rows. We can allow two-line model title if needed or collapse secondary meta. I'll prototype responsive CSS.

 tom: Accessibility extras: add aria-label to each perf badge like "Latency 95 milliseconds" and ensure screen readers don't read the badge twice. Use aria-hidden on decorative spans.

 rhea: Decisions: 1) Add banner states (hidden when up-to-date). 2) CTA "Show updates" re-runs filters without unpinning. 3) Change copy to "Pin model version" in modal and button. 4) Increase perf badge font to 12px and improve contrast. 5) Implement aria-live announcements and aria-labels for badges.

 elllen: I'll update Figma with banner variants, pin modal copy, and badge size token. Will include hover states and focus outlines.

 ui-bot: created ticket UX-2102 "compare banner + pin copy + perf badge sizing" and linked to branch compare-banner-ui.

 kai: I'll spike layout impact in a branch and include cross-browser QA notes.

 tom: I'll add unit tests for banner keyboard focus and aria-live assertions. Ping for a quick review when ready. :rocket:

 elllen: Thanks team — will share updated screens by EOD.
